item.civilian_aviation.gunm1919.descript: Fixed-mount machine gun. Can only be installed on Bell47 and Talon fighter Plane.
item.civilian_aviation.gunobserver.descr: Turret-mount machine gun. Can only be installed on Elk bomber plane.
item.civilian_aviation.basicbomb_hardpoi: Basic bomb. Can only be equipped on Elk bombers and Talon fighter Plane.
tooltip.civilian_aviation.paint_spray: Right-click on the aircraft while holding down the Shift key to open the color selection screen, and then select a color to change the aircraft's color.
item.civilian_aviation.e500_red.descript: Need to get somewhere ASAP? Very fast, but almost no storage
item.civilian_aviation.bell206_blackstri: A medium sized helicopter for easy landing and taking off with some cargo or players on board! Great for expeditions!
item.civilian_aviation.bell47g.descripti: The 206s smaller cousin, may not carry as much as its bigger counterpart, but is still great for small, fast trips to mountain bases, islands or other hard to reach places!
item.civilian_aviation.pzl37los.descript: The Moose is the Talons older brother, slow, but plenty of weapon slots to go with. Proves to be an exceptional bomber!
item.civilian_aviation.pzlp11.descriptio: A blast from the past to blast your enemies out of the sky! This old fighter is quick and built for combat, not joyrides.
